## Problem and intended outcome

Describe the requirement and why it matters. Use only fictional scenarios and data.

## Scope

Identify affected artifacts, constraints, and exclusions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The intended outcome is supported by reviewable evidence.
- [ ] Applicable validation is recorded, including limitations.
- [ ] Content is fictional and contains no confidential information or credentials.

## Validation approach

Describe proportionate checks. For cloud deployment, include cost assumptions and cleanup verification.

## Dependencies and decisions

Link prerequisites and relevant ADRs. State any unresolved decision.
